            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= yy < n and 0 <= xx < m and
                        (yy, xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color):
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        stack.append((yy, xx))
            components.append((color, cells))

    out = [[0] * m for _ in range(n)]
    for color, cells in components:
        minr = min(r for r, c in cells)
        maxr = max(r for r, c in cells)
        minc = min(c for r, c in cells)
        maxc = max(c for r, c in cells)
        cr = sum(r for r, c in cells) / len(cells)
        cc = sum(c for r, c in cells) / len(cells)

        if cr < n / 2 and cc < m / 2:       # top-left -> bottom-left
            dr, dc = n - 1 - maxr, -minc
        elif cr < n / 2 and cc >= m / 2:     # top-right -> lower middle
            dr, dc = n - 4 - minr, m // 2 - minc
        elif cr >= n / 2 and cc < m / 2:    # bottom-left -> bottom-right
            dr, dc = n - 1 - maxr, m - 1 - maxc
        else:                                # bottom-right -> middle-left
            dr, dc = n // 2 - maxr, -minc

        for r, c in cells:
            rr, cc2 = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= rr < n and 0 <= cc2 < m:
                out[rr][cc2] = color

    return out
